errors.claim: Training uses only synthetic data spanning eight grippers and thirteen objects.
errors.reason: The evidence assigns eight grippers and thirteen objects to the synthetic dataset, while also stating that D'Claw and pudding_box are excluded from training for held-out evaluation. Presenting dataset coverage as training coverage risks overstating exposure. The supplied evidence does not unambiguously establish the post-exclusion training counts, so an exact replacement count cannot be asserted.
